_about: NASA Physical Science Informatics (PSI) search for 'combustion', investigations, retrieved 2026-11-15 from https://psi.nasa.gov/physci/repo/search?q=combustion&data_source=psi&data_type=investigation (25 of 26 records shown). id, title, area and type are copied from PSI. 'topics', 'phase' and 'atmospheres' are EMBER tags assigned from the titles and objectives; entries with verified=true were checked against the investigation's PSI landing page. Before relying on any tag, open the landing page (url) and correct it here. Cite PSI data by its DOI (see 'Cite this Investigation' on each page).
